decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the map.apps ecosystem at low maintenance cost, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds some risk that it has been folded into the core product.
The niche hierarchical search bundle has had little visibility since launch, but it is cheap to keep within the map.apps bundle portfolio.
The GIS solution platform is the firm's flagship and strategic direction, so it will continue to be developed.
Mobile field data capture remains a core need for utility and public-sector customers, though competition from platform vendors' own mobile apps creates pressure.
The search extension is closely tied to the established web map apps offer and remains useful to customers despite lower website visibility.
